title: `nvs test` writes line coverage as lcov and Clover, counted into one table every context of the run shares
scope:
the first coverage report `nvs test` writes: line coverage of a `#[Test]` run, its two formats and
the two flags that ask for them, how the statement probe numbers a statement across a whole program,
and how the counts reach the runner from every context the run makes. Branch coverage, per-test
coverage, a third format and the editor's coverage view are left to a later goal.
dependsOnText:
[0018](0018.md) and [0041](0041.md) (the statement probe is compiled into every unit and checks one
flag word), [0079](0079.md) (every test runs in an isolate of its own).

summary.headline: Test coverage reports for CI
summary.body:
`nvs test --coverage-lcov <FILE>` writes which lines your tests ran, in the lcov format.
`--coverage-clover <FILE>` writes the same lines as Clover XML, the format PHPUnit writes. Every
line a statement starts on is listed with the number of times it ran. A line no test reached reads
`0`. Coverage costs nothing in a run that does not ask for it.
